method: New deterministic automated proxy; not the absent PDF simulator or human performance.

config.openingSetup: No random starting choice. Grant exactly one stack of the named buff (or none), then call the unchanged fillFloor. All later rewards are real ball selections. Stop after stage five combat clears, on death, or at the stated time limit.
config.decision: 90 uniform directions ranked by distinct circle intersections along direct + one reflected segment; fixed upgrade priorities; actual reward-ball shots.

multiKillDenominators.multiKillShareAmongHitShots: combat shots with at least one hit, shield break, or collateral kill

config.rewardCarryAttribution: reward shots clear the combat shot attribution; hits/kills before the next combat shot are reported separately by their actual stage

limitations: Small paired deterministic proxy, not the absent PDF scripts or a human study.
Starting grants are an experiment; the shipped starting-choice pool is not changed.
Fixed aiming/choice policy is insensitive to some buff-specific tactics and can favor or disadvantage individual buffs.
Subsequent random offers depend on acquired buffs and can diverge; totals therefore measure whole-run effects, not isolated causal damage.
First-five kills per shot excludes reward-shot carryover (reported separately), Boss attacks and automatic clear kills.
No statistical claim of reproducing a PDF improvement target; direct parameter and regression tests establish implementation, human testing establishes feel.
